# stb_truetype

Upstream: https://github.com/nothings/stb/blob/2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20/stb_truetype.h

Version: 1.26. SHA-256: ecd30b05e0dd4fea3a13c26810dd9e1992dc379049482c393d5a19e6b5090aab.
License: public domain or MIT, as included at the end of the unchanged header.

Only fixed fonts enter this parser: the SHA-256-verified AOSP API19 system fallback font, and the digits-only
SN Pro subset compiled into the in-game FPS counter (`src/frontend/counter_font.inc`, generated by
`tools/counter_font.py`). Untrusted APK/application fonts are outside this path.
